name: Corporate Action Pending Status 1 Code
definition: Pending status of the corporate action notification advice coming from the issuer agent.

PUBF.name: Future Publication Date
PUBF.definition: Pending due to future publication date.

ACCR.name: Incalculable Interest
ACCR.definition: Unable to calculate accrued interest. Missing payment details.

LATE.name: Late Announcement
LATE.definition: Late announcement. The declared payment date is outside of acceptable range in the past.

MATU.name: Maturing Issue
MATU.definition: Maturing issue. Redemption date is greater than or equal to maturity date.

PAYD.name: Payable Date Outside Range
PAYD.definition: Payable date outside of applicable date range.

CNPC.name: Potential Partial Call
CNPC.definition: Verify event. Potential conflicting partial call exists.

CNRD.name: Verify Concurrent Redemption
CNRD.definition: Verify event. Concurrent redemption event exists.

CNRE.name: Verify Concurrent Reorganisation
CNRE.definition: Verify event. Concurrent reorganisation event exists.
